headline: China Jewelry Sales Tumble as Consumer Caution Grips Market
summary: China’s jewelry sales have dropped significantly as household financial pressures and caution cause consumers to put discretionary purchases on hold.
why: Retail and luxury spending trends in China serve as a key indicator of domestic consumer health and broader economic momentum in the world's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: Consumer Goods
impacts.why: Weakening retail demand directly impacts sales and revenues for domestic jewelry and discretionary retailers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
